Heads up — I used a 1-7 scale on my internal sheet (legacy form I kept); happy to normalize. Proposed approach: map scales to 0-1 then scale to 1-5 before averaging. Example (my raw -> normalized):

- Technical: 6/7 -> (6-1)/(7-1)=0.833 -> *4 +1 = 4.33 -> round to 4.
- System design: 5/7 -> 3.33 -> 3.
- Collaboration: 7/7 -> 5.

If everyone agrees I'll run the normalization across the three submissions and produce a single CSV with per-dimension averages and an overall average. If anyone objects to the conversion, flag now.
